title: Chapter VIII
chineseTitle: 第 8 章：傲娇的玫瑰花

paragraphs.en: The little prince soon got to know his new flower better. On his tiny planet, flowers were simple—just one ring of petals, taking up no space and causing no trouble. One morning, a new flower sprouted from an unknown seed, capturing the prince's attention as it grew into a bud.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子很快便更加了解他的新花。在那颗小小的星球上，花朵是简单的——只有一圈花瓣，不占地方也不惹麻烦。一天清晨，一颗不知来源的种子发芽了，渐渐长成花苞，引起了小王子的注意。

paragraphs.en: The flower meticulously chose its colors and arranged its petals, eager to bloom in full glory.
paragraphs.zh: 这朵花精心挑选了色彩，排列好花瓣，迫不及待地想要尽情绽放。

paragraphs.en: Finally, at sunrise, she revealed herself. "Ah! I am just waking up," she yawned sweetly.
paragraphs.zh: 终于，在日出时分，她露出了真容。“啊！我刚醒过来呢，”她打着甜美的哈欠说道。

paragraphs.en: "How beautiful you are!" exclaimed the little prince, his admiration clear. "I was born with the sun," she added, revealing her lack of modesty but also her charm.
paragraphs.zh: “你多么美丽！”小王子赞叹道，语气中满是钦佩。“我生来就伴着太阳。”她补充说，既不谦虚也不失魅力。

paragraphs.en: The flower then demanded breakfast, leading the prince to fetch water for her. Soon, she began tormenting him with her vanity. One day, she boasted about her four thorns, saying, "Let the tigers come with their claws!"
paragraphs.zh: 花儿随后要求吃早餐，王子只得去为她打水。不久，她开始因自己的虚荣折磨他。有一天，她夸耀自己有四根刺，说道：“让老虎带着它们的利爪来吧！”

paragraphs.en: The little prince pointed out there were no tigers on his planet and that they didn't eat weeds. "I am not a weed," the flower insisted sweetly.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子指出他的星球上没有老虎，而且老虎不吃杂草。“我不是杂草，”那朵花坚持说道。

paragraphs.en: The prince felt abashed but tended to her needs, learning to deal with her demands.
paragraphs.zh: 王子感到有些尴尬，但仍悉心照料她，逐渐学会了应对她的各种要求。

paragraphs.en: The little prince continued, "I am not afraid of tigers, but I dread drafts. Would you mind having a screen for me?"
paragraphs.zh: 小王子继续说道：“我不怕老虎，但害怕冷风。你介意给我弄个屏风吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Drafts—bad luck for a plant," the flower remarked. She thought to herself, "This is a complex creature..."
paragraphs.zh: “稿费——对植物来说真是坏运气，”那朵花说道。她心里想着，“这可是一个复杂的家伙……”

paragraphs.en: At night, she wanted him to place her under a glass globe because it was cold where he lived. However, she had just arrived as a seed and knew nothing of other worlds. Feeling embarrassed about this untruth, she coughed several times.
paragraphs.zh: 晚上，她希望他能把她放在一个玻璃球下，因为他在那个地方感到寒冷。然而，她刚到这里不久，对其他世界一无所知。为此她觉得有些不好意思，于是咳嗽了几声。

paragraphs.en: "I was looking for one when you interrupted me," the little prince said.
paragraphs.zh: “你打断我时，我正想找一个呢。”小王子说道。

paragraphs.en: To make him feel guilty, she forced her coughing more.
paragraphs.zh: 为了让他感到内疚，她故意咳嗽得更厉害了。

paragraphs.en: Despite his love, the little prince began to doubt her. He took her words too seriously and felt very unhappy.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管他对她满怀爱意，小王子开始对她的话产生了怀疑。他太认真地对待了她的言语，心情非常糟糕。

paragraphs.en: "One should not listen to flowers," he confided. "One should just admire them. My flower perfumed my entire planet, but I failed to appreciate her grace.
paragraphs.zh: “不应倾听花朵的话语，”他低声说道，“只应欣赏它们的美丽。我的花香弥漫了整个星球，但我却没有察觉到她的优雅。”

paragraphs.en: Her tale of claws disturbed me, yet it should have filled me with tenderness."
paragraphs.zh: 她的爪子的故事让我感到不安，但却应该激起我的怜悯。

paragraphs.en: He continued, "I didn't know how to understand anything! Words are meaningless; one must judge by actions. She showered me with fragrance and light.
paragraphs.zh: 他继续说道：“我原本根本不懂什么！光凭言语是没有意义的，要看实际行动。她用她的温柔和光芒包围了我。”

paragraphs.en: I should never have left her... I should have seen the affection behind her little tricks. Flowers can be inconsistent, but I was too young to love properly."
paragraphs.zh: 我本不该离开她……应该看得出她那些小把戏背后的情意。花开花落，各有不同，但我当时太年轻，无法懂得真正的爱。
